messages:
maria: Quick sync 9 we need to lock MVP cuts by EOD tomorrow. Customer-Alpha requested SSA integration but thats a +3 sprint lift. Proposal: essentials-first — core chat, embeddings, SSO skeleton behind a feature flag. Defer multi-tenant dashboards and advanced analytics to v1. Thoughts?

devon: +1 to essentials-first. SSA is infra + compliance heavy. Dropping dashboards reduces frontend + infra work and lowers rollout risk.

anya: Agree on SSO skeleton + flag. That keeps sales motion alive without full SSA. I'll draft gating rules for early access.

sam: If dashboards are deferred we should remove dashboard links from the nav and surface a "coming soon" CTA. I can ship a microcopy patch + screenshot.

rafael: From model ops, recommend pinning to 13B quantized for MVP to keep latency predictable. If dashboards are cut, disable heavy batch evals in default CI to save compute.

maria: Launch criteria we must hit: 99th perc latency < 700ms for chat baseline, telemetry hooks enabled, canary with 3 pilot tenants, rollback playbook documented, and zero P0 security/SSO blockers.

devon: I'll assemble a dependency & risk matrix with effort estimates (S/M/L) and call out infra/security blockers. Will post in #docs by 17:00 today.

anya: I'll prepare the feature-flagging plan and explicit customer gating rules (who gets SSO early and how we onboard them).

sam: Microcopy + nav patch targeted for EOD; will include before/after screenshot and QA checklist.

rafael: Running perf runs now for pinned 13B quantized vs a 30B float baseline. Posting numbers by 16:30. Note: quantization may change some subtle generation characteristics.

ops-bot: Reminder: "MVP cut checkpoint" sync tomorrow 10:00 in #all-hands.

maria: Action items: devon = deps & risk matrix; anya = flag + gating; sam = nav + microcopy; rafael = perf numbers. Final cut list locked at 10:00 tomorrow; DM me if you cant make it. :thumbsup: 

devon: One question  what minimal metrics are required for launch health? If minimal, we should ship only requests/errors/latency + token cost.

maria: Minimal metrics only. Detailed analytics deferred to v1.

anya: Sales asked for tenant-level usage export. Marking as v1 but I'll write a one-pager so sales knows expectations.

rafael: I'll note perf deltas for future quantization swaps in the decision doc. Customers should be informed about possible quality tradeoffs.

maria: Good call. We'll use the decision doc to trigger a milestone reset if needed. Meeting tomorrow locks the MVP vs v1 split.

devon: Posting the matrix now: https://redwood.internal/docs/mvp-cut-matrix (updating ETA/owner).

anya: Quick poll  any strong objections to deferring dashboards?

sam: No objections, prefer a focused MVP.

rafael: Fine by me.

maria: Consensus. See you tomorrow.
